title: Spectrometerized Load Assay and Customer Certification
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Deliver a reproducible, customer-facing throughput measurement artifact (the "Spectrometerized Load Assay") and an associated certification workflow that operations and sales can use to sign off dedicated capacity commitments. This ticket drives the harness implementation, benchmark methodology, pass/fail gating, dashboards, and the customer handoff checklist. The assay differs from prior harnesses by combining multi-axis load profiles (qps, seq_len distribution, burstiness), tenant-mix emulation, and autoscaler stress probes in a single orchestrated experiment that outputs a deterministic throughput signature file for contractual evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can run deterministic multi-axis experiments against a dedicated pool and produce a JSON throughput-signature artifact and human-readable report
Benchmarks produced include p50/p95/p99 token latency, sustained throughput (qps and tokens/s), KV cache hit ratio, and autoscaler events timeline
Automated pass/fail rules: sustained throughput >= contracted qps at tail latency SLA <= configured threshold for 15m sustained window
Customer-facing certification report template (PDF) auto-generated with environment details, seed workload, and raw telemetry links
Integration tests: run in CI that validates harness against a small local cluster (smoke) and against staging dedicated pool (nightly)
test_plan: Define canonical workload profiles: conversational chat, long-form generation, high-token streaming, and embedding bursts. Parameterize seq_len, top_k, temperature distributions.
Implement tenant-mix generator: weight synthetic tenants and replay traces from anonymized production traces for realistic multiplexing.
Create autoscaler probe mode: incrementally raise sustained qps until autoscaler triggers, log scale, and verify cooldown behavior and scaling limits.
Run comparison sweeps: native model variant vs quantized variant vs cache-enabled variant; capture unit-cost and quality delta metrics.
Collect telemetry: OpenTelemetry spans, Prometheus counters, per-request trace ids, and kernel-level GPU utilization metrics exported to the dashboard.
Produce artifacts: throughput-signature.json, human report (PDF), kpi-summary.csv, and raw telemetry bundle (S3 link).
Execute customer acceptance scenario: run the assay with customer-provided sample traces and provide results within agreed SLA window.
notes: Design decision: use hybrid synthetic+replay traffic to balance reproducibility and realism; synthetic seed chosen to minimize PII risk.
Trade-off: longer sustained windows (30m) produce more stable signatures but increase test cost; defaulting to 15m for certification runs to balance cost and fidelity.
Operational guardrails: harness enforces per-tenant request caps, overall qps ceiling, and safety abort if failed_requests_rate > 1% over 1m.
Quality metric: include a lightweight semantic drift check (embedding cosine agreement) when comparing quantized variants during the sweep.
Follow-ups: integrate this artifact with sales portal so customers can request a certification run and fetch PDFs programmatically.
